{{Top|leg}}
'''Meydhu''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. During a boarding action while Meydhu served under a pirate [[Captain/Legends|captain]], the lead boarder was caught in an explosion and the crew lost their [[Deck Sweeper Stunning Blaster]]. Meydhu wanted to retrieve it but the captain pulled the pirate out.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>

While commenting on the entry for [[pulse-wave blaster]]s, Meydhu revealed that there was good money to be made by selling these kinds of archaic weapons to nuclear-level warmongering backwater [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. Meydhu was once confronted by a [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] armed with a [[micro blaster]]; the noble was stunned by Meydhu's crew and placed in the brig until his family paid a high ransom.<ref name="GFT" />

Meydhu disliked [[Disruptor/Legends|disruptor]] weapons, as the idea of causing a target's molecules to disintegrate felt creepy. Meydhu believed that those who used them were psychopaths who gave [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] a bad name.<ref name="GFT" />
